occurrences.value: (a) Exhaustive m = 2 enumeration in the x-class convention (V a random B-subset of the n = (N-1)/2 x-classes, loop counted) over 200 random bases per cell on prime-order curves at 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16 bits, B on the off-diagonal ladder, yielding p_exist per cell; (b) the closed-form table 1 - binomial(n-B, B)/binomial(n, B). The two tables are compared first; on disagreement beyond the binomial sampling error of 200 draws the control is REPLACED by the exhaustive table and the disagreement is reported to the IDEA-20260906-86cd30 lane. Then both engines fit p_fail and p_exist.

H-RELN-427bfd candidate_invariants (carried from IDEA-20260906-1f6bfe): INV-A1 derived in-record (unreviewed); INV-1 from KN-FIND-007; INV-7 and INV-A2 from IDEA-20260906-86cd30 Theorem 2 and Corollary 2d (proposal status); INV-8 from IDEA-20260808-093497; the Poisson reference from the Janson bracket of 86cd30. Written before any run; never adjusted afterward except by a versioned amendment.

At m = 2 the exact law follows from the runs distribution of IDEA-20260906-86cd30 (Theorem 2, Corollary 2d) by size-biasing, so the assumption is a theorem there; at m = 3 Janson's inequality brackets P[c = 1 | planted] and the heuristic content is the Poisson shape inside the bracket, imitating the Poisson paradigm for rare induced substructures.

INV-1 (KN-FIND-007) is the first moment and must reproduce exactly in every cell; the m = 2 law of IDEA-20260906-86cd30 is the arity-2 slice of INV-2p; the forced counts of IDEA-20260805-a25f11 (B/2 at m = 2, B^2/2 at m = 3 in the points convention) are the exact slices of INV-2pp. The FB3 battery's frozen convention (EXP-FB3-001 conservation.md: B distinct nonzero elements, all m = 3 multisets, whole group) is the plain-arm convention here and its symmetric D union -D arm is the unreduced convention here.

AS AN ATTACK none is mounted; on the prime-field frontier parallel rho with negation (0.886 sqrt N, O(1) memory), BSGS, van Oorschot-Wiener, the sumset claw of IDEA-20260829-66a876 and preprocessing S T^2 = N all dominate the realised position trivially on time, memory and queries; Pohlig-Hellman, MOV, SSSA and Weil descent are not applicable on prime-order prime-field curves. AS A REFERENCE LAW the incumbents are IDEA-20260805-a25f11 (m = 2 energy identity and floor), IDEA-20260906-86cd30 (m = 2 exact law), IDEA-20260830-c5c614 (lift with simulated null), IDEA-20260905-5a1ea2 (x-line envelopes) and IDEA-20260906-cd7b7e (E_m estimator beyond the enumeration wall); none dominates this record on the axis 'analytic null and envelope for the cluster question at general m', and each dominates it on its own axis.
Proved in-record in IDEA-20260906-86cd30 (path graph, independent sets), unreviewed there; symbolic-regression recovery control here.
Even-order curves and m = 3, as IDEA-20260906-86cd30 states.

NOT READ by this agent; ID and claim taken from IDEA-20260906-d1494b's citation list (read in full by the coordinator subagent, design of H-RELN-41562a, 2026-09-06); no file under ledger/proposals/ IDEA-20260906-86cd30 was opened.

A deterministic, pinned symbolic-regression pipeline -- primary engine an exhaustive bounded grammar search, secondary engine a hash-pinned PySR run -- that first recovers, with all constants free, at or below the canonical node count of each target and with zero residual, the three pre-registered proved-or-derived laws INV-1 (conservation mean C(B+m-1, m)/N, KN-FIND-007), INV-7 (the m = 2 exact random-base law 1 - C(n-B, B)/C(n, B), n = (N-1)/2, IDEA-20260906-86cd30, re-checked exhaustively at 8-16 bits) and INV-8 (the semi-regular reference d_reg = ceil((m(B-1)+D_S)/2), IDEA-20260808-093497), will, when fitted on the dispersion index Delta = Var_r[c_D]/mu and the k-rich counts R_k = #{r : c_D(r) >= k} (k = 1..8, coverage = R_1/N) of x-interval bases on prime-order curves over the rungs N <= 2^18 with the 2^20 rung held out, return for the E x-interval arm a Pareto front whose survivors within one null standard error of the best held-out error are all algebraically equivalent to the random-base law INV-A1 (Delta = 1 - m(B-1)/N + O((1+mu)/N)) and whose k-rich profile lies within three null standard errors of the Poisson tail N P[Poisson(mu) >= k] at m = 3 and of the runs law INV-A2 at m = 2 for every k with expected count at least 5 (the NULL outcome, which this hypothesis PREDICTS), rather than an expression with explicit N- or B-dependence beyond INV-A1 that predicts the held-out 2^20 rung by at least five null standard errors better than INV-A1, replicates on at least three curves, is absent on the relabelled Z/N random arm and is not the Z/N interval expression (the ALIVE outcome, not predicted) -- the two outcomes being distinguishable by the pre-committed criteria of EXP-RELN-141a86 and neither being reportable unless every Stage-0 recovery control is recovered.

Derived in IDEA-20260906-86cd30 (proposal status, not yet validator-reviewed): the m = 2 incidence graph is a path, so failure is an independent B-set of a path. Used here as recovery control (ii), with the closed form RE-CHECKED by exhaustive enumeration at 8-16 bits before it is trusted as a control; a disagreement replaces the control by the exhaustive table and is reported to the 86cd30 lane.

NEW. At m = 2 in the x-class convention, for a uniformly random B-subset V, the expected k-rich count is E[#{R != O : c(R) >= k}] = (N - 1) P_runs[c >= k], with P_runs the two-term loop mixture of the runs law of IDEA-20260906-86cd30 Corollary 2d, because every nonzero target has the same law.

F-CTRL-DISAGREE: the exhaustive 8-16 bit m = 2 table disagrees with the INV-7 closed form. The control is REPLACED by the exhaustive table and the disagreement is reported to the IDEA-20260906-86cd30 lane; it is not silently fixed.

IDEA-20260906-1f6bfe candidate INV-A1 derivation (internal, unreviewed) and IDEA-20260906-86cd30 Theorem 2 for the exact m = 2 case (internal, proposal status). No external citation is relied on; none is recalled beyond the elementary uniformity statement.
KN-FIND-007 (internal, established) for INV-1's exactness at every rung; IDEA-20260906-86cd30 (internal, proposal status) for INV-7.
